final_grader.about: Every run on the R8 build or later, graded again offline from its own exports by the grader at 9b076a2. A judge row keeps its recorded votes when the final grader sends the judge the same prompt; otherwise it is re-judged once (3 samples) with the final prompt. Only grader changes can move a score: world and colleague fixes can't change what a recorded run did. losses says whose the points a run still loses are: fair (the agent's), env (a world or colleague defect fixed since), or mixed.
